what: The Weekly Dispatch launch announcement (Newsletter doc, Launch announcement). Not a dispatch, no number.
caption:
The Weekly Dispatch is live.

Every Sunday, one free email tells one remarkable story from that week in the war, in full, with archival photos and the sources behind it.

Issue 001 is out today: the last stand of Taffy 3, six little carriers and seven escorts against the biggest battleship ever built, off Samar on 25 October 1944.

Sign up free at the link in our bio.
